_doc: Production packages that deliberately resolve differently in the design fork. Each needs a reason and an owner; the manifest gate reads this file.

exceptions.yaml@2.9.0: Optional peer of postcss-load-config nested under tailwindcss. Production's lock nests yaml 2.9.0 there; npm 11 resolves the optional peer to the root yaml 1.10.3 instead. postcss-load-config only reads yaml for YAML config files, which Pulse does not use. Owner: saurabh189, 2026-09-03.
